column1: Counts below update from the Status, Phase, Impact and Effort columns on the Improvements sheet.
Effort: S = under an hour, M = a few hours, L = a day or more.
Where the original list gave a range (S-M), Effort is set to M.
Phases come from the suggested order: Phase 1 first (small, high impact), then 2, 3 and 4.
Value score (Improvements, column K) = impact weight (High 3, Med 2, Low 1) divided by effort weight (S 1, M 2, L 3). Higher means better return for the work.
Cells to edit: Phase, Status, Owner and Notes (cream background, blue text) on the Improvements sheet.
Item 53 (library rules) is High impact only if the rubric limits libraries; ask the instructor.
